mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_roles report_membership JOIN roles report_role ON report_role.id = report_membership.role_id WHERE report_membership.user_id = u.id AND report_role.code = 'PAYMENT_REPORT_ALL' ) AS all_merchants, g.merchant_id FROM app_users u JOIN user_roles membership ON membership.user_id = u.id JOIN roles platform_role ON platform_role.id = membership.role_id AND platform_role.code = 'ADMIN' LEFT JOIN payment_report_merchant_grants g ON g.account_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{accountId} AND u.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY g.merchant_id

SELECT s.merchant_id FROM merchant_stores s JOIN app_users u ON u.id = s.merchant_id JOIN user_roles membership ON membership.user_id = u.id JOIN roles merchant_role ON merchant_role.id = membership.role_id AND merchant_role.code = 'MERCHANT' WHERE u.id = #{accountId} AND u.enabled = TRUE

SELECT merchant_id, name FROM merchant_stores
WHERE merchant_id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY name, merchant_id
